pitch.title: What I deliver
pitch.body: I build and run APIs and services in Node.js and TypeScript, and I look after what happens after the deploy. Today I keep a high-traffic sports portal running in production, with Next.js on the front end. Before that, I led the migration of a PHP monolith to Node services on GCP. On the side, I run two products: BEKNO, which builds websites for small businesses, and VamosMarcar, a booking system for barbershops and salons.

lance.summary: Node.js and TypeScript back end and Next.js front end for a high-traffic sports news portal: production stability, incident response and safe changes with the product squads.

points.p1: Node.js APIs: stable endpoints, data modeling, caching and query optimization.
points.p2: Core Web Vitals and technical SEO: LCP, CLS and INP, canonicals, sitemap and indexing control.
points.p3: Operations: metrics, logs and traces, root cause analysis, Cloudflare caching and redirects, CI/CD with rollback.

lance.stack: Node.js · TypeScript · Next.js · React · WordPress headless · AWS · Cloudflare

auberge.summary: End-to-end IT for a ~30-room auberge with a restaurant, during a working holiday visa in France.

points.p1: Network: guest and staff Wi-Fi isolated by VLAN, routers and switches.
points.p2: Business systems: booking PMS, restaurant POS, access management and backup routines.
points.p3: Security and web: CCTV, access control, patching and upkeep of the WordPress site.

autoavaliar.summary: Technical lead on replacing a PHP monolith with Node.js and TypeScript services on GCP and a React front end, in a product with complex business rules and workflows.

points.p1: Strangler-pattern migration through cutover: REST/GraphQL contracts and removal of legacy coupling.
points.p2: Reliability: multi-level caching, timeouts and circuit breakers; queues, workers, retries and DLQs with idempotency.
points.p3: Platform: containers, IaC, secrets management, JWT/OAuth2, TDD, CI/CD with rollback, SLOs and runbooks.

autoavaliar.stack: Node.js · TypeScript · GCP · REST · GraphQL · React · Containers
